transcription.source: DECODE transcription DOC_R674_D1892 (EK, 2020), checked against image IMG_R674_I4003
transcription.notes: One correction: after 'prius' the first number is 10, not 20. DECODE's b/g/i/o letters are 6/9/1/0.

system.summary: Reversed-alphabet substitution on numbers 1-24 (24=a ... 1=z) with vowel homophones 25=a, 26=e, 28=o, 29=u and a few higher code numbers (60, 64) for names or places; word runs embedded in Latin clear text.
system.sibling_key: DECODE R672 (MNL OL P 1238 Teleki collection, cipher keys no. 12): same reversed alphabet, but syllables Ba-Bu at 25-29 and Ka-Ku at 60-64; found after the reading, confirms the letters, does not give the codes.
system.notes: Writer's slip: 9 (q) for p once in 'Spork'.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: DECODE login cookie and /goal target setting. No target-specific intervention.

solution.what: Fetched R674 metadata, image and DECODE transcription with the saved cookie.
Parsed DECODE transcription into 244 number tokens (b/g/i/o -> 6/9/1/0); checked against the image, one correction (10 not 20 after 'prius').
Unconstrained homophonic anneal with Latin and Hungarian 4-gram LMs.
One-to-one anneal: Latin impossible (21-letter model, 25 symbols); Hungarian gave pseudo-Hungarian.
Latin anneal with at most two numbers per letter: all 8 seeds give readable Latin (tria millia hominum constituere, praesidium maiestatis vestrae reciperent).
Fixed key by hand from 'si Dominus Generalis', tria millia hominum, duo millia peditum; names Haster (Heister), Snaidau (Schneidau), Spork; nux (3=x), ab indusio.
Web search for a printed edition or prior decipherment of the draft.
Fetched R675 and keys R665-R673, R676-R690; scored each against the recovered values. R672 has the same reversed alphabet (19 agreements); its 60/64 (Ka/Ku) do not fit.
Re-decoded every run with the final key; all Latin in context. Codes 60, 64 left unread.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 241 tokens, 25 types, la order 4: reading -2.164 per letter; random keys -5.101 (z 5.8); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -2.866 (mean -2.98, z 10.0); annealer on the real text -2.573. Verdict: pass.
Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): R674 linked to transcription.txt, reading.md (text, translation, notes) and decode_out.txt; key_file key.py

Verification 5 (plain bar, 23 Oct 2026): the draft is Latin (explicit-hole bar): reading.md blockquote explicit 0.778. Rescored with research/reading_audit/v2_score.py; all entries keep read; reading_review notes record both scores.

Read share recounted over cipher words only (README Conventions, 16 Nov 2026): the sixteen bold runs inside the blockquote of reading.md, 41 cipher words, 4 unread (code 60 once, code 64 twice, Spork with the writer's slip 9 for p, which the one-digit-slip rule does not cover with a key recovered here); clear Latin words left out. The recorded 0.977 had been measured on the commentary because the measure skipped > lines. Result: read share 0.977 -> 0.902 (37/41); R674 and the target move from read to read in part; fraction_read by letter tokens (241/244) unchanged.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.164; polyphony 0.0; 3 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.573

outcome.method_basis: The reversed-alphabet key was recovered by Latin annealing with at most two numbers per letter and fixed by hand from probable words; DECODE key R672 (Teleki collection), found afterwards, has the same alphabet but different codes.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.md / decode_out.txt: 244 cipher tokens, 241 letters read, codes 60 (x1) and 64 (x2) unread.

texts.label: R674, MNL OL E 199, Wesselényi's Latin draft, c. 1663-64
texts.summary: A Latin draft of Ferenc Wesselényi, probably to Leopold I, in the Turkish war of 1663-64: if the Lord General [60] joins the regiments of Heister, Schneidau and Sporck and 2,000 foot are added, 'we' can camp at [64], which would then more readily accept an imperial garrison; otherwise 'ista nux durissima ... frangi debet'.

reading_review.note: v5 check 23 Oct 2026 (plain bar, VERIFY5_BRIEF): Latin, not French: explicit-hole bar. reading.md blockquote (bold marks and struck words out): explicit holes 0.778 (7/9), plain 0.222 (the Latin word list is small); the holes are codes 60 and 64 and doubtful clear words. Keeps read.

texts.note: Read share over cipher words only (16 Nov 2026, README Conventions): 37 of 41 words in the sixteen bold cipher runs of reading.md read; the four holes are codes 60 (x1) and 64 (x2) and Spork, whose slipped 9 for p does not qualify under the one-digit-slip rule with a key recovered here. The earlier 0.977 was scored on the commentary (the measure skipped the > blockquote) and is withdrawn.
